cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Will you give me your first turn, even if it costs you the match?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. You said you were on my side. This side has a cost.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then lend the emotion a turn so I can see it.

mechanism: A supervises a preparation arrangement while making support visible through B giving up a real competitive advantage.
confusable: D193 borrows a useful edge; D203 explicitly tests loyalty by the other person losing something.
comparison: Competitive preparation transfer differs from attendance at conflicting public events.
seedUse: Retain the support-must-cost mechanism without generic emotion-as-turn language; make the sacrifice concrete.
